scripts.generate-schema:
drizzle-kit generate --config ./drizzle.config.ts && node -e "const sql=require('fs').readFileSync('drizzle/0000_chilly_dark_phoenix.sql','utf-8');const ts='// Auto-generated by: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run generate-schema
// Regenerate after schema changes.
export const SCHEMA_SQL='+JSON.stringify(sql.replace(/CREATE TABLE /g,"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ").replace(/CREATE UNIQUE INDEX /g,"CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ").replace(/CREATE INDEX /g,"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "))+'
';require('fs').writeFileSync('src/schema-sql.ts',ts);console.log('schema-sql.ts updated');"
